RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-women panel is not evidence of anything. Single-sex panels occur routinely by chance and by who happens to hold senior roles; if a man had been hired by four men, you wouldn't read it as proof. Raising it would make you look aggrieved and would undercut any legitimate complaint.

Your real issue is narrower and stronger: a two-week silence on a reasonable request for written reasons. Chase that in writing, citing the policy or statute that applies.

Also consider that director roles often weight political judgement, stakeholder management and consultation over technical credentials. A bachelor's degree plus consultation strength can genuinely outrank a master's plus licence for that job. Get the reasons first, then judge.
